title: Counter-Selector Wave 25: support-adjusted surplus matched-control attack

comparator_lanes.label: watergate_same_event_role_adjacent_control
unmatched_features: different formal office and confirmation commitments
different succession position and legal responsibility
no common output measure beyond the binary response
comparator_lanes.finding: Ruckelshaus independently refused the same order, while Bork complied and later restored a special-prosecutor structure. The event demonstrates consequential choice variation but does not isolate a Richardson-specific output residual beyond office, commitment, and role.
comparator_lanes.reason: A role-adjacent co-refusal defeats uniqueness; a divergent action does not create a normalized performance metric.

comparator_lanes.label: nicaragua_joint_mission_contribution_control
comparator_lanes.finding: The strongest Richardson-addressable actions were jointly executed with other principals and depended on professional mission staff, observers, communications, electoral authorities, and political cooperation.
comparator_lanes.reason: Joint success and shared machinery prevent isolation of output beyond the support bundle.

comparator_lanes.label: law_of_sea_successor_role_control
unmatched_features: changed substantive instructions and policy objectives
different conference phase and external conditions
comparator_lanes.finding: Successor records demonstrate continuity and altered policy, but the changed mandate prevents a valid Richardson-versus-successor output comparison.
comparator_lanes.reason: A successor operating under changed objectives is not a resource-normalized comparator.

comparator_lanes.label: welfare_policy_revision_peer_control
unmatched_features: no peer with the same prior model and decision authority
no normalized policy output or implementation outcome
comparator_lanes.finding: The model-update sequence is attributable, but no matched peer or output surface permits support adjustment.
comparator_lanes.reason: An absent comparator cannot be converted into surplus.

candidate_support_elements: public reputation and direct access to senior principals
professional Justice Department, State Department, United Nations, OAS, and Carter Center machinery
experienced delegations, operational staff, observers, communications, legal infrastructure, and funding
extensive prior Cabinet, diplomatic, legal, and administrative experience
positive_residue: bounded model revision and live counterevidence intake are preserved
institutional continuity and non-indispensability signals remain visible
why_support_is_not_added: The same Watergate refusal was made by a role-adjacent official.
The Nicaragua outcome depended on multiple principals and large institutional machinery.
Law of the Sea successor outcomes are not comparable because the mandate changed.
The welfare-policy sequence lacks a matched peer, original decision object, and normalized outcome.
No valid comparison subtracts authority, staff, access, reputation, infrastructure, and historical conditions from observed output.

next_action: Require a genuinely independent review response and a valid resource-normalized comparator before any support-adjusted-surplus or complete-operator finding. Preserve direct-handoff absence and refuse CS-FT-01, contact, collaboration, promotion, ranking, public identity profiling, or graph construction.
